newsitem.title: USA: Speedway Motorsports sweetens N.C. Motor bid.
newsitem.headline: Speedway Motorsports sweetens N.C. Motor bid.

text.p: Speedway Motorsports Inc said it sweetened its offer to acquire North Carolina Motor Speedway Inc to $32 in cash or stock.

It said its offer, which is now $71.6 million in cash, was 39 percent more than its original bid of $23 a share in cash. It said its latest offer was at least 72 percent more than the latest offer by Penska Motorsports Inc.

Speedway said that, under its revised offer, each stockholder of North Carolina Motor may either choose to receive $32 in cash, or the equivalent amount of Speedway Motorsports common shares for each share of North Carolina Motor.
The speedways owner and operator said its offer was subject to customary conditions and any offer of stock would be made only through a prospectus.
North Carolina Motor is a one-mile oval track located in Rockingham, N.C., about 80 miles east of Charlotte. The speedway was built in 1965 by a group of local investors.
Its two National Stock Car Racing Winston Cup Series events are the "Goodwrench Service 400" in February and the "ACDelco 400" in October.
